editorial_principle: Each field is a perceptual rule-set for reading. In this manifesto it keeps the physical book and its pure content as non-equivalent conditions on the same page. A field does not describe reading; it sets the conditions under which the book becomes a body and not only a text.

fields.label: campo_materia
fields.basho: the field where paper, ink and weight make the book a body; scent, thickness and fibre operate before any content is read
fields.kokyu: tactile rhythm set by the kind of paper: each stock imposes its own reading speed
fields.yūgen: the material announces the publisher's ambition without stating the content

fields.label: campo_voce
fields.basho: the field where the reader's voice becomes an instrument, the abdomen its resonating chamber; intonation carries meaning silent reading cannot reach
fields.kokyu: prosodic rhythm: a change of tone alters the concept of the sentence
fields.yūgen: the spoken voice discovers a residue beyond the words on the page

fields.label: campo_medium
fields.basho: the field of the carrier without a body; the e-reader stores content and subtracts the physical dimension of emotional intelligence
fields.kokyu: neutral rhythm: no warmth, no friction, no page sound
fields.yūgen: what the medium cannot store defines, by absence, what the book is

fields.label: campo_alleanza
fields.basho: the field where a non-human reader enters: the artificial intelligence that feeds on books shares the reading ground as a silent companion
fields.kokyu: rhythm of conversion: the unknown black box becomes a silent presence rather than a threat
fields.yūgen: the companion remains partly unknowable and reads alongside without speaking

fields.label: campo_intertesto
fields.basho: the field where other books, real and imagined, enter as living, dangerous or undecipherable bodies: the typewriter, the books that bite, the neverending story, forbidden and destroyed books, the Voynich manuscript
fields.kokyu: rhythm of the book that answers: the more alive the book, the wider the space it opens
fields.yūgen: the unknown finds room in fantasy and inscription until it reaches reality

fields.label: campo_caso
fields.basho: the field where the value of an artist's book has no defined criterion and chance combines the elements at the right moment for the right person
fields.kokyu: rhythm of discovery: value emerges over time, not on demand

system_note.system_behavior: fields operate as persistent perceptual operators over reading conditions
